entries.head: traceql
entries.rationale: every operator the pinned grammar yields in binary positions is mapped; unary operators route through lowerUnaryOperation

guard: past exhaustive switch op over [case traceql.OpEqual; case traceql.OpNotEqual; case traceql.OpLess; case traceql.OpLessEqual; case traceql.OpGreater; case traceql.OpGreaterEqual; case traceql.OpRegex; case traceql.OpNotRegex; case traceql.OpAnd; case traceql.OpOr; case traceql.OpAdd; case traceql.OpSub; case traceql.OpMult; case traceql.OpDiv; case traceql.OpMod; case traceql.OpPower]
